episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.summary: A tragic fire arouses an officer's suspicion. Decades later, his son's heart saves a doctor who comes to town hoping to learn more about her donor.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.summary: Clara joins the search party after the latest disappearance. Back in the past, Miguel looks for answers about the fire but his efforts are shut down.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.summary: Unsettled by his findings, Miguel delves deeper into his sister's disappearance. At the Tamborada festival, Clara learns more about Carlos and the town.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.summary: Miguel's obsession with the investigation causes friction at home. Clara makes sense of Carlos' discoveries as Juan delivers Marta a shocking truth.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.summary: In 1979, a young Yesques resident receives a severe warning from his mother. Years later, Miguel's growing doubts lead to an unexpected tragedy.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.summary: After another shocking event hits Yesques, the authorities do their best to prevent a tragic outcome while a helpless Marta fears the worst.
